templates.html:
<button type="button" class="btn-tertiary{{#if underline}} btn-tertiary--underline{{/if}}" style="--bg:{{bg}};border-radius:{{radius}}px"{{#if disabled}} disabled{{/if}}>{{label}}</button>
<style>
.btn-tertiary {
  font: 500 14px/1 system-ui, sans-serif;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--bg);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.btn-tertiary--underline { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.btn-tertiary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: rgba(36,20,48,.05); }
.btn-tertiary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #241430;outline-offset:2px; }
.btn-tertiary:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }
</style>

<style>

.btn-tertiary-tw:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #241430;outline-offset:2px; }
</style>
